Implemented HHH-21130 for issue #59.

The translator now encloses each complete filter SQL fragment in parentheses before combining it with other filters or query/join restrictions. The two-line correction leaves alias rendering and parameter processing unchanged. The regression uses real Session queries and collection loading, not SQL-string or source-pattern assertions.

Test-first evidence:
- Original test-only b80f1d3c0912e0d587d0d6728f0791d1fcee9e5c, unchanged production: https://github.com/xfocus3/hibernate-work/actions/runs/44065937040 . Two cases, one behavioral failure: includeDeleted=true returned [1,2,3] instead of [2]. The false control passed.
- Minimal fix 4cf10b95f0ba9677b945c66a04dbee3b96801fe9: https://github.com/xfocus3/hibernate-work/actions/runs/44067067769 . Both cases passed; tested tree 734579cd7b9f33909f2712228038261f485b89b9.
- Lazy collection owner-isolation cases were added next. They already passed on unchanged production in run 44068061340, so they are compatibility controls, not claimed reproductions. All four cases passed with the fix in run 44068636406.
- Expanded unchanged-production baseline b6dca11795999127534d49f27e68d97dba512510: https://github.com/xfocus3/hibernate-work/actions/runs/44069473951 . Ten cases, five behavioral assertion failures, zero errors/skips: original entity true case, parameter-free OR, two enabled filters, and fetch-joined collection owner isolation for both Boolean values. The fetch join incorrectly admitted item 1 from the other owner. Already-parenthesized, non-OR and lazy collection controls passed. Tested tree e862287d72cf109328914af71f0751bdd34aca63; no formatter diff.

Final normalized commit: ee7f4cf236895bdff2599ab5ca3321235de2fb64, sole parent a0c627aa8f153354b029a4c89e1454b524b02248. Its message has the Jira key and no CI-skip directive.
